checks: OIDC discovery returns the exact issuer
JWKS returns published signing keys
Client credentials and introspection identify the expected service account
SCIM create persists and can be read through the independent API
SCIM PATCH disables the persisted user
SCIM delete removes the resource
Account API reads the actual user's profile without an admin token
Account profile update persists for the same user
An ordinary account user cannot read the privileged service account through SCIM
SCIM discovery negotiates actual PATCH filter bulk schema and resource-type capabilities
SCIM individual schema and resource-type discovery resolve declared identifiers
SCIM enterprise extension mapping survives create and independent read
SCIM filtering pagination and POST search return the actual persisted user set
SCIM projection returns requested extension attributes without unrelated user fields
SCIM user replace and extension PATCH persist independently
SCIM group create and membership PATCH persist an actual user membership
SCIM group replace PATCH and search operate on the same stored resource
SCIM membership removal is confirmed through the independent Admin API
SCIM uniqueness filter errors and ordinary-user group denial fail with the expected protocol statuses
SCIM denies ordinary-user mutations and leaves both protected resources unchanged
SCIM rejects a correctly signed token from another realm
SCIM user and group deletion remove every created resource
Browser authorization code PKCE state nonce and ID token signature validation succeed
A browser callback transaction cannot be redeemed twice
Refresh and userinfo preserve the authenticated subject
Refresh-token logout invalidates the server session
Pushed authorization request completes with the original PKCE state and nonce
Client delegation requires real user consent and issues may_act for the FGAP v2 authorized actor
Delegated exchange preserves the subject and records act without a refresh token
Standard exchange rejects may_act tokens and cannot bypass delegation
Client delegated tokens cannot call Admin APIs
Revoking FGAP v2 delegation strips may_act when the subject token is refreshed
The refreshed subject token cannot delegate after FGAP v2 permission revocation
AuthZen discovery pins PDP single and batch endpoints to the realm
AuthZen permits the persisted user resource and scope policy
AuthZen returns decision false for an unknown resource
AuthZen execute_all merges defaults and preserves mixed permit and deny decisions
AuthZen short-circuit and empty-batch semantics match the pinned server
AuthZen rejects ordinary user tokens as PDP callers
AuthZen policy revocation changes the real decision from permit to deny
OIDC dynamic registration persists and uses its registration access token
Dynamic registration delete removes the admin-visible client
Account profile projection and realm locales use the authenticated user context
Account groups show the user's actual persisted membership
Account organizations expose the user's real organization membership
Account consent writes persist and make the application visible
Account consent revocation removes the persisted grant
Account linked-account discovery reflects the real federated identity
Account unlink removes only the current user's federated identity
Account credential label updates persist on the user's actual OTP credential
Account credential deletion removes the selected OTP while preserving password authentication
Account application-session revocation removes browser-app sessions without ending the current session
Account single-session deletion persists and device discovery remains authorized
Account cross-user session and credential operations leave the other user's data unchanged
Account logout-other-sessions preserves the authenticated current session
Account logout-all-sessions invalidates the current account token
Protocol shutdown sends no token or business HTTP request
